messages:
Rachel: Pecan team here — we're green to run the joint perf/W sweep next Tue-Wed. Need final runbook and which kernel knobs Redwood wants us to flip first.
Liam: thanks — primary goals? throughput at 512 batch vs perf/W at 256?
Rachel: both. target is top 3 slots for throughput while keeping watt/seq below our baseline 0.85 perf/W.
Maya: pinging from partnerships — we want a shared one-pager for the marketplace play + a joint blog bullet to mention results.
Jorge: on the kernel side I want to test three priorities: async IO patch, mixed-precision quant path, and nvlink affinity. Plan to gate them with A/B runs.
Nathan: can we keep the initial runs on the 8xA100 config (1u rack) to match our telemetry baseline? that's what Redwood's telemetry expects.
Liam: yup 8xA100 for baseline. Then we'll snapshot 4xA100 + 8xH100 for cross-variant comparisons.
Rachel: timeline ok? Pecan lab free Tue morning and Wed full day.
Maya: Tue morning = smoke + kernel patch dry-run. Wed = full sweep. We should capture Perfboard and Marketplace-ready artifacts by Thu EOD.
Jorge: runbook sketch: 1) smoke run (no knobs) 2) asyncIO on 3) mixed-precision on 4) affinity tweaks 5) combined best-of. Each step: 3 replicates, 5k prompts (mix of 0.5/1/2k tokens).
Liam: metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, tokens/kJ, 95th tail power, kv-cache hit ratio. Add model-specific sequences for KV scaling.
Rachel: Pecan can push power sensors with 1s granularity. Please include watt normalization method.
Nathan: use telemetry tag: partner=pecan, run=pecan-1779994321, baseline_hash=redwood-v1.2.0. Export to s3://redwood-partner-telemetry/pecan/1779994321/
BenchBot: smoke-result: PASS. avg_lat=19.2ms, thrpt=2450 tok/s, avg_watts=338. Artifact link: https://ci.redwood/integrations/pecan/1779994321/smoke.log
Maya: great — can someone paste the exact kernel flags we plan to try? I want them in the one-pager.
Jorge: flags (initial): 
```
--enable-async-io=true 
--quant-mode=fp8-mixed 
--nvlink-affinity=balanced 
--batch-scheduler=dynamic
```
Liam: we'll also try `--quant-mode=4bit-gptq` as a secondary variant.
Rachel: question from Pecan infra: do you want power-capped runs? we can cap to 320W and 280W to see perf/W tradeoffs.
Liam: yes please. schedule caps: uncapped / 320W / 280W. Add a 240W exploratory run if time permits.
Nathan: note: when power-capped need to disable turbo on nodes and use pinned governor; we'll record exact CPU governors in metadata.
Maya: PR actions: - Jorge to update runbook doc - Liam to prepare eval harness + prompt set - Rachel to provision lab + power-plan - Nathan to publish telemetry path - Maya to draft marketplace blurb
Jorge: working on runbook now, will push to shared doc `docs/partnerships/pecan/perf-runbook.md` and tag reviewers.
BenchBot: scheduled full-sweep job id=PRUN-4512 for 2026-03-31T14:00Z (Wed). Will post logs to CI link automatically.
Rachel: Pecan will standby technicians Tue 08:00 PT for smoke.
Maya: brief sync 30m Tue 07:30 PT to confirm patches and access. Anyone object to that time?
Liam: works for me.
Jorge: works.
Nathan: works.
Rachel: same.
Maya: OK locking 07:30 PT Tue. I'll send calendar invite and attach the one-pager template.
Rachel: thanks all — excited to see perf/W numbers across knobs.
Liam: I'll run an initial analysis notebook after sweep and post a short heatmap + decision table.
Maya: perfect — that will feed the marketplace blurb. closing notes: include contact alias partnerships+pecan@redwood.com for the published artifacts.
